description: This file defines classes ResponseCompletionSource and ResponseCompletionSource<TResult> which implement promise-like behavior for asynchronous response handling using ValueTask and IValueTaskSource interfaces. It is part of the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace and manages completion, exception handling, and result retrieval for responses.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSource
classes.description: A fulfillable promise class for Response objects, implementing IResponseCompletionSource and IValueTaskSource<Response> for asynchronous response handling.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSource<TResult>
classes.description: A generic fulfillable promise class for Response<TResult> objects, implementing IResponseCompletionSource and IValueTaskSource<TResult> for asynchronous response handling.

methods.name: AsValueTask
methods.description: Returns the current instance as a ValueTask<Response> or ValueTask<TResult>.

methods.name: AsVoidValueTask
methods.description: Returns the current instance as a ValueTask (void).

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of the operation based on the token.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Registers a continuation to be called when the operation completes.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the completion source for reuse.

methods.name: SetException
methods.description: Completes the operation with an exception.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Completes the operation with a result.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes the operation with a Response or Response<TResult>.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the operation, resetting if valid.

methods.name: SetInvalidCastException
methods.description: Helper method to throw an InvalidCastException if the result cannot be cast to TResult.
